company.name: Powerhouse AI
company.shortDescription: Powerhouse AI provides automated inventory management services.
company.description: Powerhouse AI offers automated processes that turn warehouses into powerhouses, such as counting pallets and boxes, supporting cycle counting, reading bar- and qr-codes, checking correct placement, supporting stocktakes and audits, supporting goods received, and providing audit reports.

productsAndServices.description: A solution that uses AI-vision scanning to automate counting and data capture processes in warehouses, functioning as an add-on to WMS/ERP systems.
productsAndServices.name: Vision-AI Counting and Data Capture

productsAndServices.description: Automates the verification of inbound, outbound, and cycle count processes by checking if the correct goods and quantities are received, stored, or shipped.
productsAndServices.name: Power Count

productsAndServices.description: Identifies and extracts data points from incoming goods, checks outbound shipments, and automates data entry by scanning multiple barcodes and documents.
productsAndServices.name: Power Scan

productsAndServices.description: Uses computer vision to read logistics documents, automating data entry and cross-checking between documents and physical inventory or system data.
productsAndServices.name: Power Docs

productsAndServices.description: Automates the inbound process to receive inventory faster and reduce human error, improving dock-to-stock times.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Warehouse Inbound and Receiving

productsAndServices.description: Enhances inventory tracking and warehouse efficiency by speeding up cycle count and stocktake processes and ensuring accuracy.
productsAndServices.name: Automated AI Cycle Count and Stocktake

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $500,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,748,801 to $5,980,852, a 2.18x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 66 (+28 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
